name: Sixteen integer points with many four-point lines and no five collinear
description: construct() -> exactly 16 distinct integer points [x, y] with |x|, |y| <= 1000 and no five collinear. Maximize the number of lines containing exactly four of the points (exact). Integer configurations are a restriction of the real problem; the real value 15 for n = 16 is an upper reference, not a documented integer optimum.

sources.locator: József Solymosi and Miloš Stojaković, Many Collinear k-Tuples with no k+1 Collinear Points (2013). OEIS A006065 lists maximal numbers of 4-point lines for real configurations (15 for n = 16).
